## Ctx.bottomKeyboardT() method

Creates a bottom keyboard with template-based text buttons.

**Signature:**

```typescript
bottomKeyboardT(layout?: IKbCols, baseId?: string | null, data?: Record<any, any>): Keyboard;
```

## Remarks

Shorthand for [Ctx.bottomKeyboard()](./gramstax.ctx.bottomkeyboard.md) with automatic text button creation.

## Example


```typescript
async callback() {
  const kb = this.bottomKeyboardT("2")
  await this.reply(kb)
}
```
